blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines— Like clockwork, La Salle turned to Jacob Cortez in the clutch against Ateneo. The Green Archers’ decision to turn to Cortez paid off in an 83-76 win over the Blue Eagles in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. Cortez had struggled to find his rhythm earlier in the tournament. Before La Salle’s current two-game winning streak began with a victory over University of the East, he managed just six points on 2-of-8 shooting against Far Eastern University.
